text: The BS Computer Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan (2023-2024 Catalog) requires a grade of C- or better in each class, and a grade of C or better in CS 1336, CE 1337, CE 2305, and CE 2336 (the plan's flowchart marks CS 1436, CE 1337, CE 2305, and CE 2336 as C-or-better courses). Courses may be taken in any order, as long as prerequisites are met. Entry into Calculus I (MATH 2413 or 2417) requires MATH 2312 (C or better) or 70% on ALEKS. CE 3161 Social Issues & Ethics in Engineering has a prerequisite of junior level standing. The plan's flowchart also notes CS/SE 2340 & UNIX knowledge in connection with CE 4348 Operating Systems Concepts.

text: BS Computer Engineering Suggested Four Year Plan (2023-2024 Catalog), Freshman year.
